name: RLA event response scorecard
target: Inject the ten RFC §A12 incident classes into an isolated Nexus world and compare observed response timings and recovery outcomes against each 0.3.5 baseline and 0.3.6 target over three samples per incident.
inputs: registered RLA-ER-01 through RLA-ER-10 world events
a responder fixture returning detection, judgment, recovery, action, and success observations
fake clock and isolated Nexus state root
observations: RFC §A12 0.3.5 hand-operated baseline alongside measured 0.3.6 response
four ordered response stages per sample in run ledger and logs.db
per-incident mean detection, judgment, attribution, and recovery times
detection and recovery mode, verified success count/rate, and per-sample target verdict
